mostWorthwhile.text: Hilling the potatoes was most worthwhile: the collar and raised medium gave a clear, physically sensible way to keep developing tubers dark.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the cloth was the least informative moment on its own; the result named an extended bed but only the following step explained how it worked.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the cloth to form an extension that could hold raised growing medium around the stems.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless once the hilling was explained, though the initial cloth result left its role briefly unclear.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical crop-care details were satisfying, and I would be curious to see the harvest.
